programme.desc: 安仔父親是司機，母親是家傭，自細就在本地學校上學，與一般同齡的小朋友一樣，都是時常去球場打波，去茶餐廳食野。點解開始去唱Rap, 源自細個時家庭聚會，因為菲律賓人的聚會都一定會唱歌表演，安仔細個時就經常要被逼營業，喺一班親戚面前唱歌。到大個時見好多人都會歧視菲傭，所以就有感而發通過Rap嚟表達.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 30歲的黃嘉兆（Matthew）堅持「一紙不剪」創作出逾千作品，更曾於國際摺紙奧林匹克勇奪全球第6名。今集主持將了解他的創作歷程，並親身體驗這門精密計算的藝術.

programme.title: 撞名撞城遊一番
programme.desc: 來往熊本長洲同樣依靠渡輪，主持試食了日本渡輪上的熊本特產竹輪及餵海鷗。行程終站到了長崎多比良港，因空氣中彌漫著溫泉熱氣而以「雲仙地獄」而命名。行過著名的溫泉街，浸過足浴後，旅程也到了尾聲.

programme.title: 淡季報錯團
programme.desc: 四位年輕貌美主持人包括Ah Gi、米露迪、Pony及Tomas將出發前往泰國蘇梅島；一個深受香港以至世界各地遊客歡迎的渡假天堂；更不惜花費鉅款租住有私人泳池的別墅，準備享受陽光與海灘，誰知淡季蘇梅島竟然會天天雷雨交加，令穿上精美泰服出遊打卡的四主持大失預算.

programme.title: 食得怪 先好嗌
programme.desc: 來到風光明媚的薩丁島， Hailey 決定拋低拍檔，和有意大利血統的肌肉型男Rizzy，好好享受當地的陽光與海灘。當風度翩翩的 Rizzy 帶 Hailey 品嚐地道意大利菜時，她才明白無論身邊的男伴是誰，還是離不開食怪料理的命運..

programme.title: 日本winwin企画
programme.desc: 過往賞櫻總是匆匆忙忙，今次拍攝遇上櫻花季節，Win Win決定親自製作便當，學日本人坐在櫻花樹下，慢慢感受賞櫻的樂趣.

programme.title: 天生食材必有用
programme.desc: 最具爭議性嘅主題「黑食材」終於登場！人類對佢嘅好感度只能夠用「極端」嚟形容，有人愛佢愛到加錢都要「加餸」，有人亦都憎佢憎到要「嗌走」，「走」到一條不剩。正所謂「沒有無緣無故的恨」，原來基因決定我憎佢？！今集嘉賓 Yolica「三個女仔一個墟」，入神秘房體驗嘅人唔單只唔驚，仲非常享受，反而响出面旁觀嘅「佢」因為對主題「黑食材」又驚又討厭而惴惴不安…面對住 Yoyo、Alice、Sica 三個古靈精怪、青春可人嘅「新一代食家」，見慣風浪嘅雷師傅會如何應對？佢同 Kathy 仔又可唔可以成功為「黑食材」洗白.

programme.title: CHILL CLUB 推介
programme.desc: 一首歌背後嘅故事、花咗好多心機嘅MV、歌手同幕後音樂人嘅心血… 《CHILL CLUB 推介》星期一至五晚一於全部都推介俾你.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP: 香港浪漫篇
programme.desc: 千騙萬化大熱日劇《信用欺詐師JP》登陸香港，進擊大銀幕 ! 一向以豪華、大膽、燒腦手段行騙的三大信用欺詐師(長澤正美、東出昌大、小日向文世 飾)專程由日本來到香港釣大魚。他們住劏房、扮街坊，設下多重騙局，誓要騙取香港黑幫女帝(竹內結子 飾)的「信任」，奪取價值連城的紫鑽石。此時，天才愛情騙子(三浦春馬 飾)竟突然介入爭奪巨鑽，而早前被騙走20億的黑幫大佬(江口洋介飾) 亦現身大報復。多個大敵當前，信用欺詐師能否扭橋騙上騙，突圍而出呢.

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.sub-title: 神戶新地標｜九十九島觀光船
programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》風信子帶領觀眾前往神戶，參觀全日本首座270度環海的小巨蛋建築。生態攝影師馮漢城分享他在冰島以單車旅行的獨特經歷。阿陳則走訪佐世保九十九島，搭乘珍珠皇后號觀光船，欣賞壯麗的自然景色.

programme.title: 一語千金
programme.sub-title: 嘉賓: 香港科技園主席 查毅超

programme.title: 熨斗家族
programme.desc: 一部以三代人在清廉洗衣店工作的家庭黑色喜劇。講述家人之間溫暖的感情和激烈的矛盾，是一部重新回顧現代社會「家庭」所具有的意義的作品.

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻: 鬥煮對對碰
programme.desc: 《鬥煮對對碰》係一個煮食對決節目！每集將會有兩位廚師接受隨機挑戰：「限時速煮」、「抽食材大戰」同「清雪櫃任務」，仲有「一煲到底」等廚具考驗！喺限時壓力下，廚師要憑創意將有限食材變成美味菜式。佢哋會一邊煮一邊搞笑互窒，爭奪「鬥煮達人」寶座！夠鐘！上菜.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 初次，為了愛
programme.desc: 同時，曉利向寶賢坦白了自己的病情.

programme.title: foodpanda 呈獻: 模範的士 3
programme.desc: 道奇甚至通過賭博控制了林東賢的健身房。與此同時，東秀暈倒，張代表則在床邊發現了神秘的密碼.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 怨女俱樂部
programme.desc: 都市女性，每日面對社會、經濟、感情等形形色色的不公平，令怨氣愈積愈多。節目為她們提供出口，由主持陪伴解開心結，勉勵大家適時抒發情緒，To be happy girl in the happy world.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: 超感應學園
programme.desc: 何組長對超感社裝神弄鬼的行徑積怨已深，阿甘的異常行為又讓何組長忍無可忍，何組長下令即刻廢除超感社。原來阿甘的身體被鬼魂何達易佔據，何達易想再見生前好友凱凱一面，並渴望獲得父親何組長的諒解，超感社出手相助.

programme.title: BLUE MOMENT
programme.desc: 晴原柑九朗作為SDM本部首席代表兼氣象研究員利用智慧與知識，冒著生命危險站在最前線，保護人們的性命免受巨大氣象災害威脅，為使命奮鬥的故事。​.

programme.title: 戀愛是黑暗
programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.title: 一點點超能力
programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: 7人的逃脫
programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: 走到月亮為止
programme.desc: 多海是魔論製菓公司疲憊不堪的營銷團隊經理，她不知道自己還能忍受這種看似毫無希望的生活多久。就在這時，一心追求經濟利益的銷售部恩尚向她提出了投資加密貨幣的大膽建議。在經歷了無數次失敗後，加密貨幣成了恩尚最後的救命稻草，也是她扭轉人生的一線希望。會計部智松把花錢等同於幸福，出於害怕被拋在後面，她衝動地加入了他們。這場賭博很快變成了加密貨幣市場跌宕起伏的過山車之旅。當放棄歌唱事業、冉冉升起的公司董事咸志宇加入他們時，不可預測的混亂局面只會加深。這三個普通工人能否中大獎，一路飛向月球.

programme.title: 模範的士 3
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」存在著一位特殊部隊出身的代表的士司機替一群無法受到法律保護的被害者們找回公理.

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王
programme.desc: 在華麗成功的三位朋友面前，出現一位 10 年前因她們的謊言而成為殺人犯的老朋友，她為揭開三人隱藏在假面之下的真面目而決定背水一戰。而四位老朋友也因一位男人面臨人生漩渦，彼此展開關乎嫉妒和慾望戰爭的故事.

programme.title: 7人的逃脫
programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: 走到月亮為止
programme.desc: 多海是魔論製菓公司疲憊不堪的營銷團隊經理，她不知道自己還能忍受這種看似毫無希望的生活多久。就在這時，一心追求經濟利益的銷售部恩尚向她提出了投資加密貨幣的大膽建議。在經歷了無數次失敗後，加密貨幣成了恩尚最後的救命稻草，也是她扭轉人生的一線希望。會計部智松把花錢等同於幸福，出於害怕被拋在後面，她衝動地加入了他們。這場賭博很快變成了加密貨幣市場跌宕起伏的過山車之旅。當放棄歌唱事業、冉冉升起的公司董事咸志宇加入他們時，不可預測的混亂局面只會加深。這三個普通工人能否中大獎，一路飛向月球.

programme.title: 醫師阿修羅
programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 一點點超能力
programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.title: 戀愛是黑暗
programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.title: 天空城堡
programme.desc: 只有最頂層的0.1%人口可住在天空城堡——一個獨特的住宅社區。在上流社會的「SKY Castle」中更住著一群欲扶助丈夫事業和培育子女成為二代貴族的貴婦。然而，這些貴婦都有一個秘密不能告訴任何人。她們的財富、榮譽和最重要的權力鬥爭從現在開始.

programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: 天空城堡
programme.desc: 只有最頂層的0.1%人口可住在天空城堡——一個獨特的住宅社區。在上流社會的「SKY Castle」中更住著一群欲扶助丈夫事業和培育子女成為二代貴族的貴婦。然而，這些貴婦都有一個秘密不能告訴任何人。她們的財富、榮譽和最重要的權力鬥爭從現在開始.

programme.title: 7人的逃脫
programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: S Line
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在不久的將來，在這個世界中，人們過去的性關係通過一條發光的紅色「S線」在他們頭頂上方以視覺方式連接。一位刑警、一位神秘的老師，以及一個天生能看到這些線的少女，共同應對由這一現象引發的系列令人不安的事件.

programme.title: 模範的士 3
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」存在著一位特殊部隊出身的代表的士司機替一群無法受到法律保護的被害者們找回公理.

programme.title: 有利的詐欺
programme.desc: 講述兩名截然不同的人 ─ 缺乏同情心的騙子與同情心氾濫的律師因與邪惡抗爭，組成了一支看起來不太可能實現的聯盟後所發生的故事.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.desc: 《變成你的那一天》講述了頂流大明星江熠和女娛記者餘聲聲因為一次意外，身體和身份互換。兩人面對現狀只能相互指導，幫對方遮掩，因此發生了一系列逗趣搞笑的故事.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 變成你的那一天
programme.desc: 《變成你的那一天》講述了頂流大明星江熠和女娛記者餘聲聲因為一次意外，身體和身份互換。兩人面對現狀只能相互指導，幫對方遮掩，因此發生了一系列逗趣搞笑的故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 夏花
programme.desc: 本劇以患病少女何冉在生命最後階段學習生活、情感經歷與個人成長為線，講述她在遇到有著難以釋懷過往、幾乎對未來人生失去信心的傑出園藝家蕭寒後，兩人經過一系列誤打誤撞的、溫馨浪漫的奇妙際遇後，從彼此身上尋回各自生命中最重要卻曾經缺失的部分，重拾對生活的信心和希望，也收穫刻骨銘心愛情的故事.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 變成你的那一天
programme.desc: 《變成你的那一天》講述了頂流大明星江熠和女娛記者餘聲聲因為一次意外，身體和身份互換。兩人面對現狀只能相互指導，幫對方遮掩，因此發生了一系列逗趣搞笑的故事.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
programme.sub-title: 沈騰唐嫣重現甄嬛傳名場面
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: 亞洲新聲
programme.sub-title: 張鈺琪原創征服張靚穎
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃
programme.sub-title: 周筆暢「孤獨音樂家」唱出共鳴
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙、張靚穎、周深、單依純、黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯、方文山、黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰、首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻.

programme.title: 宇宙閃爍請注意
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 沈騰安宇對唱全是技巧
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 討論愛情裡的信任與分寸
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季

programme.desc: 繼續重磅集結，除了經驗豐富的 “全勤者” 吳奇隆外，新成員林峯、丁禹兮、林允、趙小棠也加入「追星團」；在「星空日記」的魔法下，將打游戲的宅男、疲憊的職場打工人和沉浸於網上沖浪的情侶帶出原有空間一路滑行到戶外，讓受困於都市生活的他們探尋星空與美好的秘密.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季

programme.title: 吃飯才是正經事

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫

programme.title: 你所不知道的水韻江蘇 第3季

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳
programme.sub-title: 重生之娘娘團商戰打起來了

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季

programme.desc: 由徐璐、夏之光、高瀚宇、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，通過年輕化視角拆解中醫奧秘，讓中醫藥文化穿越千年時光，讓更多的年輕人讀懂中醫、愛上中醫，看見傳統醫學在現代生活中的蓬勃生命力.

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: 亞洲新聲
programme.sub-title: 尤長靖跪地連飆三段高音
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃
programme.sub-title: 男女對唱演繹愛的訣別
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙、張靚穎、周深、單依純、黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯、方文山、黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰、首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻.

programme.title: 宇宙閃爍請注意
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 喜迎收官 出發團合唱
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 墨爾本男嘉賓再赴尋愛之約
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 海昏行 第2季
programme.desc: 延續上一季，現代人王衡與西漢海昏侯劉賀再度聯手，他們的足跡從長安延伸至豫章，並深入民間；探討他們如何運用現代思維應對宮廷權謀與民間疾苦，在面對地方積弊和幕後黑手的過程中相互砥礪，並努力改寫歷史.

programme.title: 吃飯才是正經事
programme.desc: 以美食公司為背景，通過王大蔚等七名角色的職場成長線與三對CP的情感線，展現年輕人工作與生活的酸甜苦辣；劇情採用「貪吃蛇」結構來觀眾展現了7名主角的內心世界，搭配美食隱喻與事件反轉，展現角色互幫互助完成大型直播活動的過程.

programme.title: 2026江蘇衛視跨年演唱會
programme.desc: 晚會再一次發揮「技術+藝術」的融合優勢，為文藝創作注入全新活力，推陳出新的創作理念；李宇春、周筆暢、周深、薛之謙、毛不易、單依純等實力唱將，在跨年舞台上構築起傳統文化與當代審美的精神共鳴，一起迎接更好的2026.

programme.title: 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

programme.title: 中國合伙人
programme.desc: 80's. 3 undergraduates share a common ambition - to live the American dream. They establish a tutorial school New Vision, yet the sudden fame are tearing their friendship apart..

programme.title: 脫單香氣神助攻
programme.desc: Chang-soo, a guy who has never been in a romantic relationship, earns a magical power after accidentally wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger. The supernatural power he earns is what any man would dream of, an ability to attract every woman in the world! Ara, a woman Chang-soo has been in love with, begins to sense the scent of Chang-soo and falls in love with him. While they gradually grow their connection, Ara's ex-boyfriend, James, suddenly appears and reveals Chang-soo's secret! Will the two people overcome this predicament and find true love in each other.

programme.title: 白晝如焚
programme.desc: An explosion takes place in an apartment late at night, detective Ngai Wan arrives for the investigation and a charred woman body found on spot, her name is Yin Ching. Ching is getting married with Ng Lam who grew up in a wealthy family. Though it seems to be an accident, Wan feels that something is unusual. Wan first investigate the background of Ching and finds that her mother was died in a fire accident fifteen years ago also. Before that, Ching and her mother were in a difficult relationship, Lo Chi Fung was the only person Ching could talk to. They both grew up in Pak Sin Town and disappeared together after the accident happened. Wan perseveres in the investigation but the case just like falling into the mist as everyone related to Ching are all hiding some secrets. The turning point comes out until Lo Chi Fung and his girlfriend Lam Yam show up. The two fatal cases are crossing fifteen years, everyone can be suspected. The truth is far beyond everyone's imagination behi.

programme.title: 體驗撈金魚吧
programme.desc: Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins..

programme.title: 戀之風景
programme.desc: Mann haunted by the death of her lover, struggles to accept a new life. She goes to Qingdao in search of the landscape that her love spoke of in his final days. There, she meets a young postman Lit who runs along with Mann every day in the landscape search. While Lit gradually falls for Mann's beauty and passion, she can only think of her lost-lover and the painting..

programme.title: 來福大酒店
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis..

programme.title: 左輪殺姬
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him..

programme.title: 手機見鬼
programme.desc: Lily, a popular YouTuber reeling from her boyfriend's betrayal, discovers a haunted phone belonging to Xiaoya, a bullied high school student who tragically took her own life. As eerie messages and calls pull Lily into Xiaoya's ghost world, she learns of the spirit's desire for revenge against those who hurt her. Empathizing with Xiaoya's pain, Lily begins to understand the quest for justice. However, she soon realizes that helping Xiaoya seek vengeance comes at a steep cost, and some hauntings can never truly be escaped.

programme.title: 別叫我“賭神
programme.desc: Water Ng, a typical loser who likes to gamble and takes no responsibility is asked to take care of his ex-girlfriend Jik's son, Yeung. With Jik tells him that Yeung is his son, and promised 100 thousand dollars, Water Ng agrees to be a father for one month. Soon he notices his son has Autism. He gets to understand the difficulties of raising a child along with special needs. With Jik's absence on the agreed date, Water Ng realizes why she brought him his blood. He finds his life goal while discovering Yeung's talent on the racing field, then decides to get rid of the dissipated life and accompany his son spreading wings for the dream.

programme.title: 小心眼
programme.desc: Zhang Liang is a young man who does not engage into any proper work. His secret hobby is to play with all kinds of high-tech candid technology, especially the candid photographs. He likes to upload the photographs on the Internet to share his homepage with others. Within his beloved masterpiece, he specially falls madly in love on a young air-stewardess. One day, Zhang Liang follows the young lady Amy from the airport to Tai O. In order to catch more splendid segments, Liang brings his full equipment all the way to stay in a vacation house - Mei King Village and becomes a neighbour of Amy..

programme.title: 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.

programme.title: 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..

programme.title: 忘不了
programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai..

programme.title: 追捕
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

programme.title: 意外
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: 非分熟女
programme.desc: Born in a culinary family, Siu Man has always led an ideal life - Good grades, a financially viable job and a loving husband. But one thing has always plagued her: A fear of intimacy. After the end of her sexless marriage and several life crises, Siu Man reboots her life by taking over her father's restaurant. She hires Jiahao, a ‘culinary philosopher' who takes a creative approach to cooking. To help save the restaurant, Jiahao decides to mentor Siu Man, opening her up to his culinary world. In the process, Siu Man becomes attracted to his masculinity, intelligence and his mastery of culinary skills. After seeing her usually conservative friends let loose at a wedding party, Siu Man realizes that it's time to tackle her fear of intimacy head-on. With the help of a new friend, Siu Man embarks on a journey of liberation, starting with pole dancing lessons and returning to the dating scene. When she secretly spies on Jiahao's wild tryst with another woman, Siu Man finally exper.

programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 大風殺
programme.desc: The year is 1995. Mangya, a northwestern border town of China has become a ghost town since the once-prosperous mine and border trades shut down. The town has become an island, isolated from the outside world. There is only one police station with three police officers and one gun. XIA Ran, a retired soldier has spent over a decade here. There's a saying that he's the last survivor of the battlefield but he never talk about his story. Sandstorms hit the town once a year, and a catastrophic, once-in-decade sandstorm is forecasted for this year. The storm looms on the horizon; the final transport out of town has long left. In the dead of night, five corpses are tossed into the oil tank in the town's sole gas station. The piercing silence is interrupted by a pack of uninvited guests. However, what frightens XIA Ran more than the murders is that the gas station's tank has been emptied and the town's phone line has been severed. As the sandstorm closes in on Mangya, he realizes th.

programme.title: 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.

programme.title: 一個人的武林
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse..

programme.title: 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: 你咪理，我愛你
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father..

programme.title: 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: 某日某月
programme.desc: In 1992, a heavy rainstorm caused massive power outage in Hong Kong. At that night, two young astrology enthusiasts, Moon and Sun, met under the starry night by the seaside. When their affection to each other grew, Sun was admitted into a boarding school and would move to another country in a few months under his father's plan. Like the sun and moon, the couple could hardly see each other despite that they were living in the same city, but their love endured amidst the separation and opposition from Moon's mother. Overcoming the challenges from teachers, friends and family, time has come for Sun to depart..

programme.title: 醬園弄．懸案
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.title: 封神第一部
programme.desc: Long ago, the mystic sages in Kunlun saw that humankind had descended into chaos. A King consumed by his lust for power and aided by evil beings threatened the mortal world. One Immortal was willing to sacrifice his immortality to try and save mankind. Beguiled by a beautiful Fox Demon, there is nothing that can stop the ambitious King Zhou and his band of loyal disciples. The King unleashes a brutal campaign upon the land, and forces the lords of all the other realms to deliver their sons to him as wards. Loyalty to the King is tested against loyalty to family as sons are forced to murder their fathers. Black magic aids the King, but the heavens are on the side of the hero! Can the heavens possibly save mankind? Which will prevail, power or peace..

programme.title: 我的麻煩老友
programme.desc: A-Gan is a mean and stingy but successful salesman. One day he has a car accident and meets his own conscious. His Conscious just gives him 7 days to live. A-Gan convinces it to let him live on if 7 people come and visit him. Disappointed by his colleagues' attitudes, A-Gan meets A-Tong, a girl who is as rude and mean as him. They finally change their bad personalities and A-Gan saves his own life by having 7 visitors.

programme.title: 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

programme.title: 幽靈人間II鬼味人間
programme.desc: Jack is laden with ominous anxiety the moment he and his bride Ching step into the new apartment they recently purchase at a suspiciously low price. For one thing, his new neighbors are not only unfriendly but downright creepy. Notwithstanding Jack's miraculous recovery from a near fatal accident by a hit-and-run driver outside his building, everything starts going downhill from this point forward. On the one hand, the image of a gruesome female cadaver pops in and out of Jack's vision whenever he sneezes. On the other, Ching starts behaving most bizarrely, as if she is being possessed..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 超異能特攻
programme.desc: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.

programme.title: 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.desc: A women's prison in the Northern China in 1932, Prisoner FU Yuan (JIANG Yiyan) digs a tunnel in her prison cell with a silver spoon and escapes. Inspector SONG Donglu (LAU Ching-wan) is summoned to investigate FU's escape. By tracking down the letters sent to him by FU, it sets SONG off to Hong City to unravel FU's disappearance.

programme.title: 我的婆婆黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Gucci, an ordinary teenage girl grows up in a single-parent family. In order to protect her good friend, she fights with somebody and is sent to girls' home. After release, she knows her mother died in a car accident. So she doesn't have a choice but to live with her weird grandmother, Wong Fei Hung. Gucci does not like Wong's old-fashion and strange character and they always quarrel about some unimportant issues. Gucci has fallen in love with a bartender. However, happy times always can't last, bad luck seems still follow Gucci.....

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal..

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: To achieve immortality, fox spirit Bai Shisan disguises as a young man and travels to the human world in search of a divine pill. There he befriends the innocent scholar Wang Zijin shom he later realizes is the key to his transcendence. To keep Wang safe, Bai must bond with him on his road to the imperial examination and fends off threats from mythic creatures and evil spirits.

programme.title: 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.

programme.title: 飯戲攻心
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.

programme.title: 水餃皇后
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil in Greater China, John Fok.

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth..

programme.title: Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Winnie never knows her mother. Ever since she was a toddler, her father and scientist grandfather had weaved the tale that she works for Santa Claus. Not until Winnie turns twenty does the incredible truth finally dawns on her, when she accidentally opens a freezing chamber in his grandfather's laboratory and resurrects a mysterious young woman inside. This woman is none other than Winnie's long lost mother, Gigi, who, unbeknownst to her daughter, has been cyronically frozen since a fatal car accident twenty years ago. Still very much a teenager, Gigi is shaken not only by the presence of a daughter physically older than her but also by the devastating news that her idol Leslie Cheung has passed away during her long slumber. To make up for lost time, she sets off with Winnie in search of her boyfriend, Kit, who happens to be Winnie's biological father. The Kit that Gigi used to know was a dashingly handsome young man fully convinced he would become a pop star some day. When G.

programme.title: 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love..

programme.title: 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of China's competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: 絕世好Bra
programme.desc: Samantha, the president of a renowned brassiere company, breaks the tradition and hires two guys, Johnny and Wayne, as brassiere designers, and requires them to submit novel design in 3 months. Lena, is discontent with this decision deliberately make things difficult for them, those two newcomers to the brassiere industry thus act like buffoon. The time is coming. Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'.

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body..
