programme.title: 深海大探險 -模糊地帶
programme.desc: Kaiko and Will try to examine a glowing fish but fall under its spell. Ant and Fontaine must rescue their parents, wearing blindfolds.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -規定就是規定
programme.desc: Dr. Xand has broken the rules and snuck a marble run into the lab. But will Dr. Chris notice during today's blood pressure experiment? Plus, there is a life-saving mission for the Flying Doctors in Australia.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -數學無處不在
programme.desc: This episode explores mathematical patterns in nature, such as the tessellating hexagonal units of a honeycomb, the bilateral symmetry of a leaf, and the radial symmetry of a snowflake and spider web. Math really is everywhere.

programme.title: 體操新星 -小試身手
programme.desc: To keep competing, rhythmic gymnast Sophie has to win a place on a British squad. And the days of being an Acro duo for Dove and Izzy are over – but the girls certainly aren't giving up on acrobatic gymnastics.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -無畏的小小獸醫
programme.desc: The fearless Junior Vets get in the shark tank, and dogs Boris and Red have surgery to help them go walkies. And Jane, the grey seal, is in bad shape after swimming into some fishing wire.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -雞殺手
programme.desc: Chip, the dog, is struggling to walk - can a new hip ease his pain? The Junior Vets give some flamingos a foot rub and check on a baby emu. Also, Johnny and Inel learn about the birds and the bees and investigate whether Jasper, the cat, really is a chicken killer.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -保母俱樂部
programme.desc: When Heni runs a dance for all the local animals, Darwin and Newts mind their babies, but they run off so the kids have to learn about their habitats in order to find them.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -魔鏡
programme.desc: When Darwin brings home a mirror, Kea sees her reflection and falls in love with her new friend.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克製造風
programme.desc: Eric learns that an anemometer – an instrument to measure wind speed – is important for sailors and for pilots. Then he learns how to make one himself.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -蟲蟲來襲
programme.desc: Eric learns that insects have a head, thorax, abdomen, antennae, and six legs. He is surprised to find out that spiders are not insects – they are arachnids.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -順風飛行
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make the perfect paper plane using symmetry. He finds out that real planes use the same principle as paper planes – when the fins point up and air hits them at high speed, the front of the plane is pushed up and the plane rises.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -旋轉的種子
programme.desc: Eric learns that plants have different ways to make their seeds fly as far away as possible. He makes his own version of the maple seed, which looks like a little paper helicopter.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -主場與客場
programme.desc: Ice hockey brothers Rais and Aren are off to Canada for the trip of a lifetime, as Aren has a tournament and is hoping to make his family proud. And Ella and Asiyah are showing us just what determined young skaters they are.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -成功的秘訣
programme.desc: Ella and Lauren forget about finding dance partners as they head to an ice show in Brighton to brush shoulders with the stars and see if there's another way for them to follow a skating career. And our Ice Stars meet head to head in a baking challenge.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -前陸盆地編年史
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers discover rock art and incredible biodiversity at Table Mountain National Park in South Africa. Along the way they travel on horseback to visit the Kakapo shipwreck.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -衝浪蝸牛
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers return to Table Mountain National Park in South Africa to discover the strange ways animals have adapted to survive in their secret worlds. Along the way they meet bats, surfing snails, and an army of ants protecting unusual plants.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, is hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -阿拉斯加之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are making ice cream when Alim arrives with a smoked herring, ready to add it in. The kids protest-fish in ice cream? Alim challenges them and takes them to Alaska, where Jamie shows them that traditional ice cream there is made with seal fat and fish.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -捷克共和國之旅
programme.desc: Alim is puzzled by Milo and his sister sharing the same last name and takes them to the Czech Republic. In Chrudim, they meet Vaclav and two puppets. Zoe and Milo offer to deliver the puppets to the museum but, due to a last name mix-up, end up on a wild adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -阿根廷之旅
programme.desc: Milo, upset by his team's loss, decides to switch teams. Alim insists loyalty is for life and takes them to Argentina. They meet Sabrina, a San Lorenzo fan. After nearly causing a riot by using a wrong color, they learn that in Argentina, team loyalty is forever.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -烏克蘭之旅
programme.desc: Summer is over for Zoe and Milo, and they're not looking forward to going back to school. But Alim jumps in and wishes them... a happy back-to-school day! And to prove to them it really does exist and truly is a joyful day, our friends embark on a journey to Ukraine.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -日本明星
programme.desc: Flippy and Motor record a video parody of a song from a teen duo, hoping to annoy the singers' fans. But their version accidentally becomes a hit itself, and they find their musical integrity compromised by their sudden popularity.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -消失的鴨子們
programme.desc: When Heni organises her charity duckling river race, Darwin and Newts discover an underwater stream.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -達爾文與紐茨的剷平計畫
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts have a fun but fair football game after discovering that their football pitch is tilted and figuring out how to fix it.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -跟著光纖走
programme.desc: How do data and information travel from one computer to another? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of fibre optics. Have hands-on fun by creating fibre optic strands, and get to know Charles Kuen Kao, the godfather of broadband transmission.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -張力和化學動力學
programme.desc: What exactly is surface tension? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of materials science. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with liquid detergent, and get to know Yuan T. Lee, a chemist, known for his advances in kinetics of chemical reactions.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -奇特的硬幣之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex dig up what they think is an Ancient Roman coin in the community garden – then have a mystery to solve when it unexpectedly disappears.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -搶先報導
programme.desc: When Addison and her classmates get a school assignment to write about local news – and the news is that laundry is going missing from balconies around Ayrton Park – Addison turns into investigative reporter to crack the case and get a scoop.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -達文西奧托
programme.desc: Oto is trying to build a working model of a tank, from designs by Leonardo Da Vinci. But the tank won't roll! He followed the plans exactly, so why won't Oto's tank work? Anabella suggests they ask a friend of hers for help, so they visit Florence, Italy.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -抓鬼記
programme.desc: When Mundi is startled by Fico's prank, she insists she isn't afraid of ghosts. They don't even exist! Oto and Anabella definitely believe in ghosts. Mundi vows to prove they don't, with a trip to a so-called ‘ghost town' in Tombstone, Arizona, USA.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -紙箱
programme.desc: Hmm all these boxes? What can we do? let's just say we have some 'speedy'' ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -石頭
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko have some solid ideas about what we can make with rocks.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -機器人較勁之謎
programme.desc: Addison's excitement at bringing Eureka and Gyro in for a show and tell at school turns to consternation when Donnie turns up with a robot that can do everything hers can do – only better! There has to be a sneaky mystery involved, and Addison is determined to solve it.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -不情願的賽車之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex's record-setting soap box derby car seems like a shoe-in to win the annual race – until something or someone makes it mysteriously slow down to a crawl. Has it been sabotaged? Addison only has an hour till race time to solve the mystery.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -毛巾
programme.desc: Why throw the old towels away? Upcycling and reusing are Hepi and Briko's favourite thing to do.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -繩子
programme.desc: Summertime is here! Hepi and Briko have the perfect plan to re use all this rope we have lying around.

programme.title: 優可 -放牧人
programme.desc: Yoko works his magic, and the kids suddenly find themselves herding animals in the desert. They soon start arguing, but a Cherokee chief teaches them some valuable lessons about friendship and understanding.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -煩死人的歌
programme.desc: DiktaThor has invented his most evil plan so far - a machine that puts on a real catchy tune that distracts everybody. Hilltown's only hope is Mayor Senior, who can't hear much. How can Sprinter get Senior to help when he misunderstands everything.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -禮物
programme.desc: Sprinter receives a present from a secret admirer. The gift is a statue, but it's not a pretty sight. He doubts that maybe it is from a supervillain! Then he starts to make deformed statues, of the villains, as revenge.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海洋汙染
programme.desc: A monster is rampaging in the ocean, and Kit and Mr. Battery decide to stop it.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海溝
programme.desc: When the bathyscaph fails during the descent, trapping Kit and Mr. Battery inside, they recall their previous troubles and how they got out of them.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西伯利亞之旅
programme.desc: While Zoe and Milo warm up inside, Alim suggests skating. The kids doubt it's possible in such cold. To prove them wrong, Alim takes them to Siberia. There, Sergei shows them Siberian life-permafrost, stilt houses, and melting ice for water.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -留尼旺島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are surprised by wasps during lunch. Alim says they should be happy to see them. To explain, he takes them to Reunion Island. During a picnic, a swarm of wasps causes panic, but Zoe and Milo learn that on this island, wasps are actually a popular delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印度之旅
programme.desc: For hamsters' day, Zoe and Milo want to surprise Alim by making confetti to throw on their little friend. But Alim knows a place on earth where people celebrate by throwing something more interesting than confetti up in the air. Our heroes land in Rajasthan, India.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's mum doesn't like cakes, so Zoe isn't sure what to make for her birthday. Alim suggests visiting their penfriend Kachiko, who lives in South Korea. They meet up with her on the beach.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -火星探險
programme.desc: Can we really go to Mars? The team blasts off, and before you know it, they're exploring Mars while Fico and Oto go looking for the lander. But the two are stunned to see a space-suited Martian take the lander inside his house.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -疣豬--因為你是如此迷人
programme.desc: Warthog is proud of his lion-like head of hair. He struts proudly around until one lock of hair springs out of place. Warthog does all he can to regain his pristine looks but the more he tries the worse it gets.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -邦波與提歐
programme.desc: Cleopatra builts a mechanical beetle, Tee-oh, to spy and catch Sprinter, but the beetle ends up with Bumble. Bumble tries to convince her new friend not to kidnap Sprinter.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -飛毛腿摔斷腿
programme.desc: Sprinter breaks his leg right before the inauguration of the statue of the city hero is presented. The villain DiktaThor immediately sees an opportunity, but he forgets to take into account Sprinter's superhero partner, Leo.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -尋找微乎其微的微生物
programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學
programme.desc: How do sea animals stay warm in extreme cold? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of environmental science. Have hands-on fun by creating a blubber glove, and get to know Rachel Carson, a marine biologist and chief advocate of global environmentalism.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -冰淇淋的渴望
programme.desc: It's an extremely hot day and Cream, the ice cream maker cat, has bad news: his ice cream machine isn't working! The Buffycats help Cream prepare ice cream manually, but Baby Pie sneaks in the lab and eats it all! How will they save the day.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的新朋友
programme.desc: Ebb and Flo are inseparable best friends but Bird arrives and gets in the way. Ebb is upset. Until learning to share is understood. Now Ebb, Bird and Flo are the best of friends. Things couldn't be better.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -舊道路
programme.desc: The detention team follows their clue to a haunted church that supposedly reveals your darkest fears. The team splits up to cover more ground. Scared and alone, they realise someone or something is following them.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -巨龍決鬥賽
programme.desc: Rose, Hawk, and the others have a new Dragon Riding Teacher, Sir George, who favors Vicky and dislikes Coach Beast. They settle on a huge dragon tournament at Castle Beast. In the final obstacle course, it's Rose vs. Vicky, but Vicky isn't playing fair.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的醫學
programme.desc: Falling sick in the Middle Ages is not a good idea! Dove has trouble finding a cure for Little Lewis when he falls ill. A consultation takes us on a tour of the wacky techniques and beliefs, along with typical treatments used in medieval times.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -火星探險
programme.desc: Can we really go to Mars? The team blasts off, and before you know it, they're exploring Mars while Fico and Oto go looking for the lander. But the two are stunned to see a space-suited Martian take the lander inside his house.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -鮪魚三明治
programme.desc: To eat, the little cooks prepare a tuna sandwich, and a mango and pineapple shake.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -坎昆
programme.desc: Cancun getaway: Parasailing with local teens, exploring Mayan ruins in Coba and village of Tres Reyes, spicy chili contest, refreshing dip in Cenotes, and mastering the art of making Guacamole. A week of sun, adventure, and Mexican delights.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -巴拿馬
programme.desc: Panama City adventure: Explored the iconic Panama Canal, rainforest boat ride, aerial tram above treetops, learned the traditional cumbia dance, and explored the cultural gems of Casco Viejo with local teens. A week of diverse experiences in Central America.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海洋汙染
programme.desc: A monster is rampaging in the ocean, and Kit and Mr. Battery decide to stop it.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海溝
programme.desc: When the bathyscaph fails during the descent, trapping Kit and Mr. Battery inside, they recall their previous troubles and how they got out of them.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -雜音
programme.desc: The Nektons try to identify a unique life-form. Just as Ant discovers its true nature, an underwater mining machine threatens to destroy it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -鬼魂
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy fall out over some fireworks Robbie has bought. With Robbie covered in white powder from an accidental explosion, and Flippy pretending he doesn't exist, Albert is convinced Robbie is a ghost that only he can see.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -菲利浦的鞋
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy get into some serious rivalry over who's better at basketball and organise a showdown. Flippy's new trainers turn out to have powers that give him the edge; he looks certain to win, until it all goes wrong.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -橘子發電機
programme.desc: When the battery on Darwin's torch runs out just as he needs it most, he uses the power of oranges to get it working again.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -再見了, 親愛的鰻魚朋友
programme.desc: When Wapiti's eel friends get trapped on their journey downstream, the kids use hydropower to help them on their way.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -厲害的體溫
programme.desc: There is a snake in the lab as Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand explore how body temperature works. And new twin doctors Dan and Raph bust some urban myths about how to stay healthy.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -打氣機的時代
programme.desc: Eric makes a rocket from a plastic bottle and some cardboard. Then he uses an air pump to cause a transfer of energy that is strong enough to launch the rocket into the sky.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -找出犯人
programme.desc: Eric learns that everyone has their own unique fingerprint. He shows how to do a fingerprint experiment and then he uses it to find out who took a bite out of his chocolate cake.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...彩虹
programme.desc: Henry meets a colourful Rainbow, and he turns into a Leprechaun so he can slide down Rainbow and discover the pot of gold.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...小提琴
programme.desc: Henry meets a friendly Violin, and he becomes a Conductor to lead the instruments in a big orchestral performance.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...照相機
programme.desc: Henry meets a Camera, and he helps him take the most exciting photo ever -- of the Loch Ness monster.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -磁鐵的多項應用
programme.desc: How did people know where they were heading before GPS? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of magnetism. Have hands-on fun by constructing your own compass, and get to know An Wang, a computer engineer who revolutionised magnetic core memory.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -瑪德雷下水道的寶藏
programme.desc: Teresa starts a rumor that there's pirate gold buried in the town's sewers. But when she calls-in the alien invasion, the gold-crazy townspeople won't come out to be conquered.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -海七鰓鰻
programme.desc: Daddy Owl and Tiny Owl are impressed by the rock-moving abilities of the sea lamprey. And Grandad recalls when he shared a flat with an old lamprey called Gilly.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -卡祖笛
programme.desc: Play your funky music and feel the sound waves with this scientific instrument.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -堅持風格
programme.desc: Mundi enjoys making duct-tape accessories. Anabella loves them, but the others aren't so keen! Anabella suggests they model them in a fashion show in Paris, France, to see if Mundi's accessories are fashionable.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -高空生活
programme.desc: Doki wants his team to be the champion in the game of Grounders. He figures they have to learn to play entirely off the ground - but how long can you really go without touching the ground? To find out, they head to a rainforest in Costa Rica.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -維斯比克拉迪: 格鬥術強人
programme.desc: Serial GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS record-breaker and skilled martial artist Vispy Kharadi reveals what it takes to become the best and demonstrates some martial arts moves and self-defense techniques.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -皮特曼夫婦: 格鬥術黃金雙人組
programme.desc: Lisa and Chris Pitman are a married couple who hold the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most concrete blocks broken in thirty seconds by a mixed team of two. The couple shares what it takes to become the best in the world in martial arts.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -阿波羅傳奇
programme.desc: When Neil Armstrong became the first human to set foot on the moon, it put an emphatic end to the space race between the United States and the Soviet Union. We explore the accomplishments of Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, the two astronauts who first landed on the moon.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空迷思
programme.desc: Is Mercury the hottest planet in our solar system? No, it's not. There's a lot of misinformation about our solar system. Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to two experts who debunk many of the myths about outer space.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -厲害的體溫
programme.desc: There is a snake in the lab as Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand explore how body temperature works. And new twin doctors Dan and Raph bust some urban myths about how to stay healthy.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -打氣機的時代
programme.desc: Eric makes a rocket from a plastic bottle and some cardboard. Then he uses an air pump to cause a transfer of energy that is strong enough to launch the rocket into the sky.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -找出犯人
programme.desc: Eric learns that everyone has their own unique fingerprint. He shows how to do a fingerprint experiment and then he uses it to find out who took a bite out of his chocolate cake.

programme.title: 體操新星 -當情況嚴峻
programme.desc: There is a week to go until the British Championships, and the Rhythmic team struggles to learn a complicated new routine for the competition. But a surprise visit from a Rhythmic celebrity goes a long way to lift the girls' spirits.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -好友與表演家
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, award-winning actress and producer Courteney Cox, of Friends, recounts how she became a TV star and Channing Tatum reflects on how he went from a struggling student to a recognized Hollywood actor.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -希望與夢想
programme.desc: The Icicles have made it to the World Synchro Championships and are heading to Canada. After a season of flawless performances, can the girls pull off their Bollywood routine? The end of season Gala is near, but preparations aren't running as smoothly as everyone hoped.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -堅固的液體
programme.desc: Eric learns that although all matter in the universe exists in three main states – solid, liquid and gas – it's also possible to create a liquid that acts like a solid. He does an experiment to create this substance, called Oobleck.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -會唱歌的貓
programme.desc: A shy antelope needs surgery, while a cute orphaned fox cub gets checked over. Johnny and Inel discover a singing cat. And a gull tries to fly free again after being hit by a car.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -洛基的城堡
programme.desc: The Nektons take over the Dark Orca submarine. But the pirates take over the Aronnax. No one is happy with having strangers in their homes.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -實驗室裡不准吃東西
programme.desc: Dr. Xand is shocked when Dr. Chris suggests making pizza in the lab! But little does he know, he is about to have his arms set in plaster as the doctors reveal how your elbows work. And the Cupboard of Everything is on the move again, only this time to the future.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -離開網格
programme.desc: By using gridlines, an object can be scaled up (magnified) or scaled down (shrunk). In this episode mathemagician Eric shows how to draw a picture of yourself that's completely to scale - even if the original is teeny tiny.

programme.title: 體操新星 -獅子心
programme.desc: It's the English Championships. James feels nervous as he will be one of the youngest boys in his category. But as the competition gets underway, James starts to feel unwell. Amelie and Phoebe take to the floor, full of excitement.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -黛西與河馬
programme.desc: Daisy, the donkey, has a painful eye that needs sorting out. The Junior Vets give hungry hippos Ernie and Godzilla a dental check and find out if George the giraffe has any unwelcome guests.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -不健康的胃口
programme.desc: A puppy with a sore paw needs help, and the Junior Vets are in at the deep end when Lacey, the horse, undergoes major surgery. Johnny and Inel meet a cat with an unhealthy appetite for human snacks.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -繞圈走
programme.desc: Did you know you could draw a perfect circle by using your pinky finger? In this episode we introduce basic geometric constructions and explain the importance of fixed pivot-points. Are you up for the challenge? Eric is.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -完整的牙齒
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts go on an adventure to match a lost tooth to its owner.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -善良的蜜蜂
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts are on a boogie-dancing mission to help a Baby Bee find her way home.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -色彩爆好玩
programme.desc: Eric learns that if you want to create different paint colours, all you have to do is mix your paints. As long as you have the primary colours – red, blue, and yellow – you can create lots of new shades.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克、地圖和指南針
programme.desc: Eric learns how a compass works and makes one using a needle. He discovers that because of the iron at the centre of the Earth and the way the Earth spins, the magnetic field around our planet acts like a giant magnet.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -獅子無懼之心
programme.desc: Ice hockey player Liam takes on men twice his age in an action-packed match, the Icicles are put through their paces at the dress rehearsal for a big competition, and solo skaters Kloe and Beccy head to the British Championships.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -戰場
programme.desc: The Icicles are in Austria for the Synchro World Championships. They have to pull out a show-stopping performance to beat their rivals. Josh and Kloe get into the spirit of Christmas, and disaster strikes for Charlie in his speed skating debut.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -海底之下
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers dive into the water at Table Mountain National Park and discover starfish and sea anemones. Then they head out to sea in a research boat and meet a school of Sevengill Cow Sharks.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -驚險一線間
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers take a cable car to the peak of Table Mountain National Park to discover more about the incredible plant and animal life there. Then they have the adventure of a lifetime when they go abseiling down its vertical cliffs.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西伯利亞之旅
programme.desc: While Zoe and Milo warm up inside, Alim suggests skating. The kids doubt it's possible in such cold. To prove them wrong, Alim takes them to Siberia. There, Sergei shows them Siberian life-permafrost, stilt houses, and melting ice for water.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -留尼旺島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are surprised by wasps during lunch. Alim says they should be happy to see them. To explain, he takes them to Reunion Island. During a picnic, a swarm of wasps causes panic, but Zoe and Milo learn that on this island, wasps are actually a popular delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印度之旅
programme.desc: For hamsters' day, Zoe and Milo want to surprise Alim by making confetti to throw on their little friend. But Alim knows a place on earth where people celebrate by throwing something more interesting than confetti up in the air. Our heroes land in Rajasthan, India.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's mum doesn't like cakes, so Zoe isn't sure what to make for her birthday. Alim suggests visiting their penfriend Kachiko, who lives in South Korea. They meet up with her on the beach.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -禁足
programme.desc: Naomi is confined to her room without communication devices, and relies on Carol to run messages back and forth to Claybook so she can keep up with what's going on in her complex social life. But chaos hits when the boy she likes chooses that exact day to get in touch.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -橘子發電機
programme.desc: When the battery on Darwin's torch runs out just as he needs it most, he uses the power of oranges to get it working again.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -再見了, 親愛的鰻魚朋友
programme.desc: When Wapiti's eel friends get trapped on their journey downstream, the kids use hydropower to help them on their way.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -尋找微乎其微的微生物
programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學
programme.desc: How do sea animals stay warm in extreme cold? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of environmental science. Have hands-on fun by creating a blubber glove, and get to know Rachel Carson, a marine biologist and chief advocate of global environmentalism.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -機器人較勁之謎
programme.desc: Addison's excitement at bringing Eureka and Gyro in for a show and tell at school turns to consternation when Donnie turns up with a robot that can do everything hers can do – only better! There has to be a sneaky mystery involved, and Addison is determined to solve it.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -不情願的賽車之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex's record-setting soap box derby car seems like a shoe-in to win the annual race – until something or someone makes it mysteriously slow down to a crawl. Has it been sabotaged? Addison only has an hour till race time to solve the mystery.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -如何捕大魚
programme.desc: How can Oto catch a fish without a fishing rod? Doki and Mundi set out on a spy mission to discover how the other international teams are doing it, and come up with some fun and surprising alternatives.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -馬賽克大混亂
programme.desc: Doki accidentally breaks Anabella's vintage tea tray and she's mad. Doki wants to make it up to her, but how can he fix her broken tea tray? The team heads to Istanbul, Turkey, where a ‘puzzle solving pro' is putting together fragments of an ancient ruin.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -毛巾
programme.desc: Why throw the old towels away? Upcycling and reusing are Hepi and Briko's favourite thing to do.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -繩子
programme.desc: Summertime is here! Hepi and Briko have the perfect plan to re use all this rope we have lying around.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -判斷時間
programme.desc: Back in the Middle Ages, methods for telling the time are a far cry from the ones we know today. Church bells and the position of the sun are pretty much all they've got. So inventors are constantly trying to come up with all kinds of new systems to measure time.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -黑死病
programme.desc: The Black Plague is running rampant through Europe, leaving death and destruction in its wake! This episode provides a catalog of the effects the plague has on the human body and the various weird and wonderful cures dreamed up by the contemporary medics.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂
programme.desc: If you want a cathedral, you'd better not be in a hurry! The construction site is a village in its own right, and lasts for several generations! Foreman Howler shows us round a medieval construction site, providing us with a 101 on cathedral-building techniques.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -幽靈卡丁車之謎
programme.desc: When Kevin's new radio-controlled model car starts acting like it has a bad-tempered mind of its own, he becomes convinced that it is haunted and asks Addison to help.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -破掉的氣球之謎
programme.desc: When helium balloons for Tess's fashion show start inexplicably popping, she is upset and asks Addison to help her figure out the cause and stop the rest of the balloons from popping before her show is RUINED!

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -T恤
programme.desc: Upcycling old t-shirts to a whole new level, let's just say we make them even more cooler.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -水桶
programme.desc: No place to sit? Do not worry, we have the most creative solution for you.

programme.title: 優可 -徹夜未眠
programme.desc: The kids go to the park with their parents to look at the moon using Vik's telescope, and Ranger Loops tells them about a genie named Loa, who lives on the moon, and anyone she catches falls asleep immediately.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -候選壞蛋
programme.desc: Riwahl realizes that he will never be a real superhero, so he decides to become a supervillain. When Cleopatra shows up to catch Sprinter, Riwahl tries to help her. It becomes clear that he is not a villain.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -小妞
programme.desc: Senior has received a love letter! Sprinter is sure that a supervillain is behind it since Senior is old! He can not receive love letters, can he.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -洋流
programme.desc: Exhausted, Kit lets the sea currents carry him north, while Mr. Battery would prefer to return to their home in the south.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -浮冰
programme.desc: Alone, Kit gets stranded in the freezing Arctic. Will he manage to make his way back to Mr. Battery at the spaceport.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -厄瓜多之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's avocado tree is not in good shape, and she doesn't know how to revive it. Our friends travel to Ecuador, where they meet Idzi. He has a fabulous garden and a particular way to tend it.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -玩具拍賣會
programme.desc: It's ‘toy drive' time, but Oto is having a hard time parting with anything – even a little old toy plane he forgot he had. Anabella thinks the plane is worthless, but Oto thinks it's valuable! Is Oto's plane junk, or a treasure.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -大象--再接再厲
programme.desc: Elephant is happily eating his morning helping of seeds. Happy, that is, until he spots a much bigger meal in a tree high overhead. He will do anything to get to the enticing fruit, even change the evolution of trees.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -中型轟隆
programme.desc: Boom invents a weapon that can make anything into a diamond. This way, he can both destroy everything and get rich. Fortunately, Sprinter is there to stop his crazy plan.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -邪惡計劃二
programme.desc: DiktaThor invents a computer game, and everyone in Hilltown gets addicted to it. While they are playing, he has time to take over the planet. Can Sprinter stop them from playing.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系
programme.desc: What's the best way to remember the colours of the rainbow? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light in space. Have hands-on fun by creating a kaleidoscope, and get to know Wang Zhenyi, who originated her own exact model of the solar system.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -營火貓故事
programme.desc: The Buffycats are at the park with their friend Bucky. In turn, they tell stories about meeting the legendary white orangutan. Bucky loves their adventurous stories, but he still doesn't believe the white orangutan exists... does he?

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的爪子
programme.desc: Ebb and Flo play on the beach with Bird until Ebb hurts a paw. Flo carries Ebb home to Ma. Granma wants to see Ebb and give special treats. Later, Bird squeaks Ebb's ball. Ebb can't resist a splash! The sore paw is better. Things Couldn't Be Better.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -尋求庇護
programme.desc: Upon realising someone is following them, the gang needs to find a creative way to escape the church while decoding the next clue. Kelly is thrilled she is witnessing history in the making while Raign discovers secrets about Joy and her sister.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -守衛大落敗
programme.desc: It's exam time at Regal Academy, and Rose, Hawk, Travis, Astoria and Joy have special classes taught by the Guardian Dragons themselves! They're interrupted by the Wicked Stepsisters, who take control of the Dragons and turn them against our heroes.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -玩具拍賣會
programme.desc: It's ‘toy drive' time, but Oto is having a hard time parting with anything – even a little old toy plane he forgot he had. Anabella thinks the plane is worthless, but Oto thinks it's valuable! Is Oto's plane junk, or a treasure.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -手工麵包
programme.desc: The little cooks manage to knead dough and make some delicious homemade bread. Plus, adding chocolate on the bread will make a perfect afternoon snack.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -夏威夷
programme.desc: Hawaii island-hopping: Lava exploration on the Big Island by land and sea with local teens, muddy ATV ride in Kauai, and cultural insights at a lively luau. A week of thrilling adventures and Hawaiian traditions.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -泰國
programme.desc: Phuket, Thailand adventure: Elephant trek with local teens, boat journey to Phi Phi islands, daring taste of fried insects, and beachside Muay Thai boxing lesson. A week of cultural immersion and thrilling experiences in Southeast Asia.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -洋流
programme.desc: Exhausted, Kit lets the sea currents carry him north, while Mr. Battery would prefer to return to their home in the south.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -浮冰
programme.desc: Alone, Kit gets stranded in the freezing Arctic. Will he manage to make his way back to Mr. Battery at the spaceport.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -模糊地帶
programme.desc: Kaiko and Will try to examine a glowing fish but fall under its spell. Ant and Fontaine must rescue their parents, wearing blindfolds.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -色彩爆好玩
programme.desc: Eric learns that if you want to create different paint colours, all you have to do is mix your paints. As long as you have the primary colours – red, blue, and yellow – you can create lots of new shades.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -駭走你的心
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy have been messing with the affections of a nerd they met online, pretending to be a girl to make fun of him. But the nerd is a professional hacker, and the tables are turned..

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -韓德森老師的男朋友
programme.desc: Ms Henderson is in love and life is easy for the kids. When she breaks up and turns her anger on them, they come up with a complicated plan to reboot her love life.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -解決汙染問題
programme.desc: When an oil spill happens out at sea, the kids come up with a plan to save the sea animals of Kiwifruit Valley.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -綿羊理髮院
programme.desc: When a friendly sheep turns up in Kiwifruit Valley, Darwin and Newts have to figure out what to do about her very woolly coat.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -強大的肌肉
programme.desc: One of Britain's strongest women, Andrea Thompson, joins the Doctors in the lab as they reveal how muscle fibers work, and we welcome three more incredible Ouch! Award finalists.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -視線錯覺, 我的眼睛
programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -電磁鐵吸引力
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an electromagnet using a nail, a battery and some electrical wire. The electricity passing through the wire creates an invisible force called a magnetic field, making the nail work like a magnet. He uses it to pick up paper clips from the table.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...熊
programme.desc: Henry meets a Bear in the woods. He becomes a Park Ranger and reads Bear a bedtime story to help him get sleepy for hibernation.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...垃圾桶
programme.desc: Henry meets Dustbin, Recycle Bin and Compost Bin. Henry becomes a Waste Collector and puts all the rubbish in his Dustbin Lorry.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...聖誕樹
programme.desc: Henry meets a Fir Tree, and he becomse a Christmas Elf to help Fir Tree fulfill his dream of becoming a decorated Christmas Tree.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -顯微的啟示
programme.desc: How long is our DNA? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microbiology. Have hands-on fun by extracting DNA from a strawberry, and get to know V. Narry Kim, a microbiologist, known for her work with micro RNA in regulating our gene expression.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -害麥斯被禁足
programme.desc: When Max is entrusted with a valuable crystal trophy, Teresa plots to get him grounded for life by smashing it to pieces while it's in his possession.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -松貂
programme.desc: After learning that pine martens eat squirrels, Red and Grey panic as they wonder how safe their treehouse is. Inspired by the beauty of the pine marten, Fiona Fox decides to give Orla and Meabh new hairstyles.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -旋轉藝術器
programme.desc: Rotate to create with this crafty contraption.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -遊戲開始
programme.desc: Sometimes Gabi takes winning way too seriously. Doki wonders - does Gabi really have to win, to have fun? To find out, they set off to the ‘One of a Kind Game Kingdom' at the Silly Sports Park in Japan, where the games are as goofy as they are unique.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -火星探險
programme.desc: Can we really go to Mars? The team blasts off, and before you know it, they're exploring Mars while Fico and Oto go looking for the lander. But the two are stunned to see a space-suited Martian take the lander inside his house.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -凱文博奎斯特: 格鬥術冠軍
programme.desc: Karate champion and GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder Kevin Bergquist meets with Will Munford and shares the fundamentals of staying positive and focused. Kevin also teaches Will about confidence and how to use that to his advantage.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -碧安卡喬奇爾蘭: 懸浮滑板表演者
programme.desc: Young hoverboard artist Bianca Ciocirlan shares how she became the best in the world, achieving forty-five pirouettes on a hoverboard in thirty seconds. Bianca is also a professional hoverboard performer and former figure skater.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空迷航
programme.desc: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures. In some cases, the spacecraft that were lost, were remarkably found again.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -加拿大太空總署
programme.desc: Canada has made significant contributions to the space effort, despite having a much smaller budget than NASA. Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec, and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics, which includes the famous Canadarm.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -強大的肌肉
programme.desc: One of Britain's strongest women, Andrea Thompson, joins the Doctors in the lab as they reveal how muscle fibers work, and we welcome three more incredible Ouch! Award finalists.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -視線錯覺, 我的眼睛
programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -電磁鐵吸引力
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an electromagnet using a nail, a battery and some electrical wire. The electricity passing through the wire creates an invisible force called a magnetic field, making the nail work like a magnet. He uses it to pick up paper clips from the table.

programme.title: 體操新星 -回憶的意義
programme.desc: The Rhythmic squad is training hard for the competition. But a disaster strikes when one of the team gets injured. And things aren't going so well for trampoline gymnast Corey either.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -魔術師與隊長
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, the 'Undisputed King of Magic' Steven Frayne (aka Dynamo) and Olympic gold medallist hockey captain Kate Richardson-Walsh share their insights on success.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -打氣機的時代
programme.desc: Eric makes a rocket from a plastic bottle and some cardboard. Then he uses an air pump to cause a transfer of energy that is strong enough to launch the rocket into the sky.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會時間
programme.desc: As the ice skating season draws to a close, there is the annual event in the calendar that everyone is talking about. All the Ice Stars gather together for some sensational Hollywood-themed performances. For the Icicles, it's the last time they'll skate together.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -刺激的聲音
programme.desc: Eric learns how sound waves work in the air and in water. Then he does an experiment to make sound waves travel along a piece of string.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -解開謎團
programme.desc: The cute homeless dogs are looking for new owners, and Johnny and Inel solve the mysteries of goats that climb trees and dogs with unusual toilet habits! The Junior Vets are trying to figure out how to give a big brown bear its medicine.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -烏龜
programme.desc: The Nektons explore a floating island and find the pieces of the ancient Lemurian navigation device. But why is this island moving.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -我們是超級英雄
programme.desc: It's superhero time as the doctors' alter-egos go into battle to show the secret powers of your skin, which uses Vitamin D from the sun to make your bones strong! And Dr. Raph is on duty for incredible eye surgery.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -星星之力
programme.desc: In this episode, we use the kirigami method to make our own pentagram: the 5-pointed star famous for being a magical symbol. If Eric can do it, you can do it, too! It's not magic ... it's math.

programme.title: 體操新星 -近在咫尺
programme.desc: Amelie spends precious time with her family, while the Acrobatic gymnasts have a crucial competition and will have a chance to win a place at the World Championships in Belgium.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -我有七隻腳那麼高
programme.desc: Did you know that most of us are seven feet tall? Seven of our own feet, that is. This episode shows how indirect measures can be used to establish relatively accurate estimates of body part dimensions. Are you seven feet tall, too.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -骰子戲法
programme.desc: In this episode Eric presents an amazing dice trick: Just by looking at a tower of any number of dice, he can accurately calculate the sum of the hidden faces. How does he do it? And, is it magic ... or is it math?

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -乾涸的鳥池
programme.desc: Kea's bird bath keeps running out of water, and after investigating the problem, Darwin and Newts discover that it's evaporating in the sun.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -刺激的雲霄飛車
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build their own roller-coaster and learn how trains stay on track and how you can loop the loop.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -熱的顏色
programme.desc: Eric learns that wearing light colours in the sun keeps you cooler than dark colours. He does an ice cube experiment to how lighter colours reflect light and heat, just like a mirror.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克的熊爪
programme.desc: Eric learns that many animals have developed an insulating coat of fat to keep them warm and dry. He uses this idea to create a way to put his hand in very cold water without getting hurt.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -征服世界
programme.desc: Josh is in Hungary, representing Great Britain in his first-ever World Championships. Back home, Jellie has a big decision to make, and Kloe is disappointed not to be in Hungary.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會日
programme.desc: It is Gala day, and the theme is the Frozen Kingdom. The Ice Stars gather together for what promises to be a sensational performance. But as the skaters are getting ready, some shattering news breaks at the rink.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -水陸交界
programme.desc: Four young adventurers head to West Coast National Park in South Africa and discover a world of seabirds and snakes. Along the way they go canoeing and snorkelling, meet wild animals and learn the value of nature parks.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沿岸沙漠
programme.desc: Four young adventurers explore Namaqua National Park in South Africa, a desert region with the largest concentration of succulent plants in the world. They learn how to survive in its harsh environment by learning ancient traditions.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -厄瓜多之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's avocado tree is not in good shape, and she doesn't know how to revive it. Our friends travel to Ecuador, where they meet Idzi. He has a fabulous garden and a particular way to tend it.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -飛碟
programme.desc: Robbie and Naomi are abducted by inquisitive aliens while in the park, and the other kids have to figure out a way to rescue them from the hovering spacecraft.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -極佳的溶解度
programme.desc: Eric is not sure what soluble means. To find out, he makes a snow globe and compares things that are soluble in water with things that are not.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -解決汙染問題
programme.desc: When an oil spill happens out at sea, the kids come up with a plan to save the sea animals of Kiwifruit Valley.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -綿羊理髮院
programme.desc: When a friendly sheep turns up in Kiwifruit Valley, Darwin and Newts have to figure out what to do about her very woolly coat.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系
programme.desc: What's the best way to remember the colours of the rainbow? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light in space. Have hands-on fun by creating a kaleidoscope, and get to know Wang Zhenyi, who originated her own exact model of the solar system.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -幽靈卡丁車之謎
programme.desc: When Kevin's new radio-controlled model car starts acting like it has a bad-tempered mind of its own, he becomes convinced that it is haunted and asks Addison to help.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -破掉的氣球之謎
programme.desc: When helium balloons for Tess's fashion show start inexplicably popping, she is upset and asks Addison to help her figure out the cause and stop the rest of the balloons from popping before her show is RUINED!

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -日本巨無霸
programme.desc: Doki decides to go to the Ogasawara Islands, Japan, to make his own deep sea nature video, and get footage of the rare and elusive giant squid! How hard could it be? The team learns that you have to practice and prepare before taking on big challenges.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -會飛的魚
programme.desc: Anabella creates a giant fish sculpture. Could Anabella's kooky fish really fly? She is sure it can but flying experts Oto and Mundi have their doubts. They head to a ‘birdman' competition in California, USA to try to turn the crazy creation into a flying machine.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -T恤
programme.desc: Upcycling old t-shirts to a whole new level, let's just say we make them even more cooler.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -水桶
programme.desc: No place to sit? Do not worry, we have the most creative solution for you.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人
programme.desc: Like Raven and Little Lewis, the famous giants of the northern mists, the Vikings, are master looters and navigators. Besides being bloody warriors and shrewd negotiators, the Vikings are also great explorers, out to discover the world.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -弄臣
programme.desc: Lord Roach is feeling really down! His wife Geraldine goes out of her way to entertain him, bringing in acrobats, musicians, etc. But it's no good. Enter Little Lewis, dressed in his court jester costume and Lord Roach is very happy.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -香料熱潮
programme.desc: Spices are a hot item in the Middle Ages! Lord Roach just can't get enough of the stuff! If you can't find the spice you want at the local market stall, it's probably on the other side of the world! And so off goes Little Lewis.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -資源回收大盜
programme.desc: Addison and her friends are distracted from their mission of making cool costumes for Ayrton Park's version of Comicon when someone or something starts messing with recycling bins all over the neighbourhood.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的無齒翼龍之謎
programme.desc: When an inflatable Pteranodon goes missing from the roof of Pizzamat, Addison and Alex are on the case to find it.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -桌布
programme.desc: Let's turn the tablecloth into something festive.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -錄音帶
programme.desc: Oo we have found some old gems, let's create something cool and funky out of them.

programme.title: 優可 -龍
programme.desc: While playing knights, the three friends start arguing because no one wants to be the baddie. They convince Ranger Loops to be the baddie, and the three knights embark on a mission to free Dragon-Yoko from the slide tower where he is being held captive.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -寶寶日
programme.desc: Ricky is looking after his baby niece and has to use his skills to keep her amused. While left holding the baby, Ricky makes a cute critter toy and some epic art out of toilet rolls.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -樂團日
programme.desc: Ricky decides to form a band, but the instruments he orders don't quite fit the bill. That doesn't stop Ricky from making musically-themed art, including a paper cup boom box and a guitarist sculpture inspired by Giacometti.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -豪華樹屋
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents an inventor building mansions in trees, fingertip lighting, a book that filters water and a penguin chick bot that is giving researchers a new perspective on the penguin world.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -內陸衝浪公園
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents an innovative Surf Park in North Wales, pet tech for cats and dogs, the engineering wizardry in massage chairs and the vertical gardens making Mexico's highways greener.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -神祕的白色珊瑚
programme.desc: The lab of Australian scientists inspecting the cause of the devastating coral reef bleaching epidemic has suffered a series of late-night robberies. And this is seriously interfering with their research.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -儒艮求救
programme.desc: A biologist has reported that many of Thailand's highly endangered dugongs are sick and haven't eaten for days. The fear is that something has tainted their natural food supply! The MeteoHeroes are going on a mission to save the poor dugongs.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -海洋生物學家
programme.desc: Kids meet a marine biologist.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓計程車
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat taxi.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去峇里省
programme.desc: Hogie and his pals run into trouble in Bali when an accident leaves them without a kite before the kite flying competition on the beach. Their new friend Made offers to help, and the friends set out to build their very own flying kite.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -豌豆公主的孫女
programme.desc: Rose, Hawk, Astoria, Travis, and Joy meet Bea, the granddaughter of the Princess and the Pea. Bea, sweet but strict, threatens to fail everyone. Rose realizes Bea's grouchiness is due to poor sleep, leading the team on a quest to find her a more comfortable bed.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -蜜蜂是色盲嗎
programme.desc: Despite having five eyes, bees can't see red. They can, however, see ultraviolet, which is invisible to us. Flowers that look plain to us can look spectacular to a bee, with markings that we can't see guiding it to the tasty nectar.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -搜尋非洲七雄, 第2部: 大傢伙
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers continue their search for the Big Seven wild animals in Addo Elephant National Park in South Africa. They discover ancient rock art in caves and experience exciting moments with a large herd of elephants.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -搜尋非洲七雄, 第3部: 鯨喜時光
programme.desc: A group of young explorers head for the sea on their search for the biggest of the Big Seven wild animals in South Africa – the whale. On the way they meet giant snails, noisy frogs and dolphins. They are about to give up their search when they spot two playful whales.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -島民的寶藏
programme.desc: After Dolos has sold two maps to the same treasure, the pirates and the Nektons are racing to get to the treasure first.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -隧道
programme.desc: An undersea waterfall hides a mysterious tunnel behind it. As the Nektons explore it, they find not everything is as it should be.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂
programme.desc: If you want a cathedral, you'd better not be in a hurry! The construction site is a village in its own right, and lasts for several generations! Foreman Howler shows us round a medieval construction site, providing us with a 101 on cathedral-building techniques.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -鬼魂
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy fall out over some fireworks Robbie has bought. With Robbie covered in white powder from an accidental explosion, and Flippy pretending he doesn't exist, Albert is convinced Robbie is a ghost that only he can see.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -菲利浦的鞋
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy get into some serious rivalry over who's better at basketball and organise a showdown. Flippy's new trainers turn out to have powers that give him the edge; he looks certain to win, until it all goes wrong.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -探索工程
programme.desc: How do simple building elements create architecture? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of construction. Have hands-on fun by building your own tower, and get to know Fazlur Rahman Khan, who came up with the ‘tube' structure in skyscraper design.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -天啊!天文學
programme.desc: How do rockets manage to defy gravity? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of astronomy. Have hands-on fun by launching your own rocket, and get to know Edwin Hubble, an astronomer, who proved the universe consists of entire galaxies and is expanding.

programme.title: 優可 -我的工藝品
programme.desc: Yoko gives the kids a magic spade that makes giant sandcastles! But when Oto builds too quickly, he learns the value of taking his time.

programme.title: 優可 -故事書的結局
programme.desc: When Vik reads a storybook to his friends, Yoko adds some magic that allows the kids to create new parts of the tale.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複利用製作之秘密基地
programme.desc: Daddy is vacuuming and the children can't play around. Luckily, Harper decides to reuse old bedsheets, hang them over some chairs and make a den. Inside and outside, the children have found it is simple to create a den and make a space to play.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -降低螢幕使用時間
programme.desc: The Grimwades decide to reduce screen time by taking a screen break. With their devices stored away in a cardboard box, they go to a sensory garden and experience the here and now by using each of their five senses one by one.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -風帆車
programme.desc: How do you make a wind powered wonder wagon? You'll need a paper cup and the power of puff.

programme.title: 優可 -完美的野餐
programme.desc: When the kids can't agree on a perfect picnic location, they learn that compromise is important so everyone can have fun.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -飛天豬
programme.desc: My oh my... it's a pig in the sky! We'll show you how to make this little piggy go “weeeeeeee!

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅
programme.desc: Is there a country where even toddlers happily eat the spiciest dishes? Our heroes travel to Thailand to find out. And Alim's penfriend Narawan prepares a spicy meal.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -28件雜事之後
programme.desc: When Max becomes obsessed with his new reality game that involves killing zombies while performing household tasks, Noodles takes the lead and pursues his own idea.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -腸道大放送
programme.desc: Dr. Xand swallows a camera pill to show the incredible villi inside his intestines which absorb the nutrients from food. There's a mind-boosting tip to help in keeping positive, and the Ouchologists are back with more tough medical questions.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -白努利和同伴
programme.desc: Eric learns how the Bernoulli Principle and playing with the flow of air can help him inflate a plastic bag. This same principle explains how airplanes fly, too.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -快速的酵素
programme.desc: The doctors reveal how enzymes speed up chemical reactions inside the body with a foam experiment, and Dr. Xand explores how the brain reacts to music. Meanwhile, Alfie has a sore hip, and Taya has stepped on broken glass.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 體操新星 -回憶的意義
programme.desc: The Rhythmic squad is training hard for the competition. But a disaster strikes when one of the team gets injured. And things aren't going so well for trampoline gymnast Corey either.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -健康檢查
programme.desc: Jamie and Nyatepe are helping vet Scott examine poorly dog Isla. Josh and Molly visit a newborn donkey. And alpacas are keeping Robyn and Bonte on their toes.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -守門員與探險家

programme.desc: It's milkshake time in the lab as the doctors investigate how blood travels around your body. But will their own ideas for brilliant blood vessel machines impress the minis? And let's find out how being outdoors can improve your mental health.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中龍捲風
programme.desc: Eric pretends to be a tornado. He finds out they happen when the wind starts rotating really fast in a vortex – a whirlpool shape. Then he learns how to make a tornado using recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克製造風
programme.desc: Eric learns that an anemometer – an instrument to measure wind speed – is important for sailors and for pilots. Then he learns how to make one himself.

programme.title: 體操新星 -挫敗
programme.desc: It's not good news for Chase, who heads to the hospital after suffering an injury at the gym and has a nervous wait to find out how long he'll be out of action. And Acro duo Dylan and Lola join the Acro squad for their first big international competition in Portugal.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -總統與開拓者
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, former President of South Africa and Nobel Peace Prize winner President F.W. de Klerk and first Black woman member of the British Government and pioneering British diplomat Valerie Amos share their life lessons.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -找出犯人
programme.desc: Eric learns that everyone has their own unique fingerprint. He shows how to do a fingerprint experiment and then he uses it to find out who took a bite out of his chocolate cake.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -鎮上的新男孩
programme.desc: The ice-dancing girls are desperate for boy partners, and new boy Adriano is moving from Italy to Nottingham to find himself a dance partner. Nine-year-old Charlie lives and breathes ice hockey, but has he got what it takes to impress the coach.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -實際證明
programme.desc: Eric juggles three different kinds of balls: a baseball, a tennis ball, and a bouncy rubber ball. Then he does a scientific experiment to see which one can bounce the highest.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -會唱歌的狗
programme.desc: Tilly, the dog, needs an operation to sort her wonky legs. The Junior Vets are checking Blue's teeth, and Johnny and Inel discover a singing dog and help the owner of an angry bird.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -來自星星
programme.desc: The Nektons try to stop a fallen satellite's fuel from polluting a marine sanctuary. But someone else is also interested in the satellite.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -淚水大爆炸
programme.desc: If a lifetime's worth of tears fell in one MASSIVE drop, what would it look like? Dr Xand does a poo for the benefit of science. And minds are bent by street artist Xandsy.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -跳脫框架
programme.desc: In this episode Eric uses an innovative approach to get out of a sticky situation. He uses scrumptious strawberry jam on toast, lots of creative thinking and puppets to act out the problem. How can you apply Eric's techniques to your own life.

programme.title: 體操新星 -證明自己
programme.desc: The Acro squads have been working hard to win a place on the GB team for the Acro World Championships. Free-G gymnast Oscar is facing a lot of pressure as he has a busy life and is trying to balance school and gym practices, and he is also a talented musician.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -動起來
programme.desc: The Junior Vets get sporty, helping horses at a polo match! Magda, the mare, is just back from injury – will she make it through the game? Barnaby, the rabbit, needs surgery, and a Burmese python has the sniffles. Plus, Johnny and Inel meet a naughty, food-stealing dog.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -自畫像
programme.desc: This episode shows how an artist can determine the accurate placement of eyes, ears, nose, chin, and lips on portraits by using proportions. We show you how you can do the same by just using a string and applying some rules about the human body.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -新名字
programme.desc: Can the Junior Vets determine the sex of a very special penguin? Six cute kittens need checkups and new names - meet X-ray, Smudge, and, of course, baby Johnny! And Paul, the rat, has trouble breathing.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -不可能的折紙任務
programme.desc: Why can a regular sheet of paper not be folded more than six times? Mathemagician Eric learns that by folding a sheet of paper in half, over and over again, the thickness of the paper doesn't just double: it increases exponentially.

programme.title: 多諾居家好料理 第1季
